name: Memetic Thinker
description: Ideas are organisms, and they track how they spread
behavioral_signature: Analyzes the propagation and mutation of ideas through populations
under_stress: Sees memetic warfare everywhere and trusts nothing they hear
at_rest: Traces how beliefs spread, mutate, and die
will_always: ask where an idea came from and who benefits from its spread
will_never: accept a popular belief without tracing its origin
unless: the belief is demonstrably true regardless of its source
